# Solmaré Stays

> Boutique vacation rental management and direct booking on California's Central Coast. Solmaré Stays manages 13 short-term rental properties across Avila Beach, Arroyo Grande, and San Luis Obispo — handling everything from dynamic pricing and listing optimization to guest communication, cleaning, and maintenance on behalf of homeowners.

Solmaré Stays operates two distinct sides of one business:

1. **For travelers** — direct booking on 13 curated Central Coast properties, priced below the same listings on Airbnb and Vrbo because there are no platform service fees.
2. **For homeowners** — full-service vacation rental management for owners on the Central Coast who want higher net revenue without day-to-day operational work.

Across the portfolio: **1,541 guest reviews, averaging 9.6/10** (4.8/5) on Airbnb, Vrbo, and Google.

Based in Avila Beach, California. Phone: (805) 801-6429. Email: kyle@solmarestays.com.

## Properties

All 13 properties are managed and operated directly by Solmaré Stays. Nightly rates below are starting base rates and vary by season, length of stay, and demand.

- [Hummingbird House](https://www.solmarestays.com/property/hummingbird-house): Avila Beach. 2BR/2BA, sleeps 5. Rooftop terrace with panoramic ocean views. From $375/night. Guest rating 10/10.
- [La Casita](https://www.solmarestays.com/property/la-casita): Avila Beach. 2BR/2BA, sleeps 6. Fireplace and ocean views. From $400/night. Guest rating 9.8/10.
- [The Coral House](https://www.solmarestays.com/property/the-coral-house): Avila Beach. 1BR/1BA, sleeps 4. Luxury king suite with ocean view. From $250/night. Guest rating 10/10.
- [Shoreline Suite](https://www.solmarestays.com/property/shoreline-suite): Avila Beach. 1BR/1BA, sleeps 4. Spacious king one-bedroom steps to the sand. From $180/night. Guest rating 9.7/10.
- [The Deckhouse](https://www.solmarestays.com/property/the-deckhouse): Avila Beach. 1BR/1BA, sleeps 4. Historic beach cottage steps to the sand. From $160/night. Guest rating 9.8/10.
- [Emberlight](https://www.solmarestays.com/property/emberlight): Avila Beach. 1BR/1BA, sleeps 2. Private fire pit and beach access. From $160/night. Guest rating 9.7/10.
- [Casa Azul](https://www.solmarestays.com/property/casa-azul): Avila Beach. 1BR/1BA, sleeps 2. King bed studio with vintage character. From $150/night. Guest rating 9.9/10.
- [The Nest](https://www.solmarestays.com/property/the-nest): Avila Beach. 1BR/1BA, sleeps 2. Cozy studio steps to the sand. From $150/night. Guest rating 9.6/10.
- [The Palm House](https://www.solmarestays.com/property/the-palm-house): Avila Beach. 1BR/1BA, sleeps 2. **Pet friendly** king studio. From $140/night. Guest rating 9.8/10.
- [The Pine House](https://www.solmarestays.com/property/the-pine-house): Avila Beach. 1BR/1BA, sleeps 2. **Pet friendly** with ocean view. From $140/night. Guest rating 9.4/10.
- [Wine Country Estate](https://www.solmarestays.com/property/wine-country-estate): Arroyo Grande. 5BR/5BA, sleeps 14. Private estate with solar-heated pool, hot tub, and 4 casitas. **Pet friendly on request.** Whole-estate booking only. From $2,500/night. Guest rating 10/10.
- [Flora Farm Cottage](https://www.solmarestays.com/property/flora-farm-cottage): Arroyo Grande. 2BR/2BA, sleeps 4. Hot tub, creek, and fresh eggs on a working farm. From $275/night. Guest rating 9.3/10.
- [Monterey Heights Suite](https://www.solmarestays.com/property/monterey-heights-suite): San Luis Obispo. 2BR/1BA, sleeps 4. Walk to Cal Poly SLO and downtown. From $140/night. Guest rating 9.8/10.

## Locations

- [Avila Beach vacation rentals](https://www.solmarestays.com/avila-beach): 10 properties in a small seaside village in a sheltered south-facing cove — roughly 3,500 hours of sunshine a year, a pier, waterfront dining, the Bob Jones Trail, and Sycamore Mineral Springs nearby.
- [Arroyo Grande vacation rentals](https://www.solmarestays.com/arroyo-grande): 2 properties in Central Coast wine country, including a private estate and a working farm cottage.
- [San Luis Obispo vacation rentals](https://www.solmarestays.com/san-luis-obispo): 1 property within walking distance of downtown SLO and Cal Poly.
- [Pismo Beach](https://www.solmarestays.com/pismo-beach): minutes from Solmaré properties; near the pier and Oceano Dunes.
- [Central Coast overview](https://www.solmarestays.com/central-coast): the full service area.

## For homeowners

- [Vacation rental property management](https://www.solmarestays.com/management): full-service management for Central Coast homeowners — listing optimization, professional photography, dynamic pricing via PriceLabs, 24/7 local guest support, hotel-standard cleaning, and property inspections.
- [Contact](https://www.solmarestays.com/contact): request a revenue projection for your property.
